name: Clorazepate
metabolism: Rapidly converted to active nordazepam, which undergoes hepatic hydroxylation to oxazepam and further conjugation. Elimination is mainly urinary as conjugated metabolites.
summary: Clorazepate is a long-acting benzodiazepine that acts as a prodrug for desmethyldiazepam, an active metabolite responsible for most of its therapeutic effects.
